name: legal-for-founders
description: Covers founder legal basics with step-by-step checklists: incorporation (Delaware C-Corp vs LLC), IP assignment, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, NDAs, consulting agreements, fundraising documents (SAFE, priced round, board consents), and when to hire a lawyer, citing YC, CooleyGO, Clerky, and Orrick resources. Use when a founder is incorporating, drafting customer terms, raising money, or deciding whether they need a lawyer. Not legal advice. Triggers on: "legal for startup", "incorporate", "Terms of Service", "Privacy Policy", "NDA", "SAFE", "startup legal", "founder legal basics".
